add_point.description: Create a free or construction point.

move_point.description: Move an existing point to new coordinates.

add_line.description: Create a straight segment between two points.

add_curve.description: Create a cubic Bézier curve through four control points.

add_construction_line.description: Create a reference-only line that never becomes a cut edge.

set_construction.description: Mark an entity as construction geometry or convert it back to a cut edge.

delete_entity.description: Remove an entity and any constraints referencing it.

add_constraint.description: Attach a geometric constraint to one or more entities.

remove_constraint.description: Detach a constraint from the sketch.

add_seam_allowance.description: Attach a seam allowance (mm) to a cut line or curve edge.

remove_seam_allowance.description: Detach the seam allowance from an edge.

solve.description: Rebuild the sketch by running the constraint solver.
